description: A client-facing performance report for a brand over a date range, in YOUR name (your white-label business name and logo; with none saved the report has no "Prepared by" line and its emails come from the report's own brand, never another of yours; senderName picks one of your own brand names), never Hermoso's: for an agency's clients, or a platform's own users. It covers organic posts (per channel: posts, reach, engagement, followers, and the top posts with their pictures) and paid ads on every connected ad platform (spend, results, cost per result, top ads), with highlights. The numbers are read ONCE when it is made and frozen. action create (default): from / to (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), or month (YYYY-MM), or days; default the previous month. Returns a share link anyone with it can open (expires in expiresInDays, default 90; action revoke withdraws it) and a PDF link. summary:true adds a short written summary (billed at its exact model cost in credits, said in the answer; the highlights are free). action schedule: email it every month to recipients (dayOfMonth 1-28, hourUtc, period previous_month or last_30_days, message, summary), each email linking the page and its PDF; each recipient can stop it from the email. action list: this brand's reports and schedules; cancel_schedule: scheduleId. brands ("all" or a list) runs create / schedule / list on several brands at once (past one brand the first call previews; confirm:true after the user agrees). Reading the numbers and the PDF are free.

brands.description: several brands at once: "all" or a list of ids or names (list_brands)

confirm.description: with brands: true after the user agreed

message.description: schedule: a note at the top of each email

senderName.description: the sender name: your white-label business name (the default) or one of your own brands’ names

name: branded_report
title: Performance report in your name
